xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5470: docs: the Flywheel and the backlog

plan.title: docs: the Flywheel and the backlog
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Docs-only change: one new page, its docs.json nav entry, link edits in eight existing user pages across features/, configuration/, cli/ and the repo root, and a two-line pointer fix in docs/FLYWHEEL.md. The 'subsystems' are Mintlify doc directories, not code subsystems. The links are meaningless without the page and the page is unfindable without them, so sibling issues would ship orphaned or broken docs. Items that edit the page are serialized by blocks edges.

narratives.Problem: The Flywheel, its /flywheel page, its three switches, Needs-you items, parking, pan parked and the backlog sequencer have no user page. Users find only vision.mdx (a roadmap with stale claims), the order-books page and scattered mentions, so the feature is hard to find and easy to misread.
narratives.Proposal: Write features/flywheel.mdx, labeled early, covering the loop, its CLI and page controls, pickup rule, switches, page anatomy, Needs-you items, parking versus pan parked, the backlog sequencer page and its files, and known limits. Every fact is verified against code on main (PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5470.md). Add it to docs.json after features/planning and link it from eight related pages and docs/FLYWHEEL.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code, prompt, skill, role or changelog changes
- No fix for #5544 (the hardcoded author gate) or for stale UI tooltips
- No rewrite of vision.mdx, order-books.mdx, auto-merge.mdx, cloister.mdx or any page beyond the D-7 link edits
- No description of what roles.flywheel.scope does (no consumer exists)
- No full SequenceDoc schema reference
- No screenshots
- Never run mint validate --fix

autoDecisions.summary: Page path features/flywheel.mdx, placed in the Features nav group directly after features/planning
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the path; the Flywheel drives issues through the pipeline and planning pages that precede it.

autoDecisions.summary: Label it early with sidebarTitle 'Flywheel (early)', a Warning callout linking /vision, and a Known limits section
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'Label it early'; introduction.mdx already uses '(early)'; concrete verified limits are more useful than a bare label.

autoDecisions.summary: Filed #5544 for the hardcoded eltmon author gate and cite it as a known limit instead of hiding it
autoDecisions.rationale: Every claim must match code; the skill's security rail names the maintainer's login, which matters to any other operator.

autoDecisions.summary: Require UAT is described as the merge-policy fallback that holds ready PRs for a Merge click, not as 'requires a passed UAT'
autoDecisions.rationale: Code wins over tooltips: shouldHoldForUat in auto-merge-policy.ts; the merge gate never requires a passed UAT verdict.

autoDecisions.summary: Document the two meanings of parked separately and state that pan parked does not list label-parked issues
autoDecisions.rationale: pan parked reads classifyParked (paused, troubled, stopped, pan ask, zombie, 6-hour idle); the loop parks by label or .pan/parked.md.
The only Flywheel images date from 2026-06-04, before the lane board, and the issue forbids inventing UI.

autoDecisions.summary: Cross-link edits limited to one or a few lines per page, plus a correction of the dashboard-views Order books row and the docs/FLYWHEEL.md Needs-you row
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the PAN-5468 precedent; open accuracy audits #5499, #5502 and #5503 own the rest of those pages; the two corrected rows are wrong about this feature.
The issue states docs-only changes need none.
